task_description: Write a method in Dafny to reverse only the vowels of a given string (where y is not a vowel).
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ReverseVowels(s: string) returns (result: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The resulting string is a permutation of the input string with only vowels reversed
    - All non-vowel characters remain in their original positions
    - The order of consonants and other non-vowel characters is unchanged
    - The length of the output string is the same as the input string
